Green Goods starter templates

These layouts were created for brand kit v3 using the existing Figma artwork and the canonical dark green (#367D44). They are new kit additions, not templates exported from Figma.

SVG: editable text and vector artwork. Install the bundled Inter Regular and Fraunces Regular fonts before editing in Figma, Illustrator, Inkscape or another SVG editor.
PNG: a rendered reference at the stated dimensions; text is not editable.
Slides: 16:9 cover and content layouts.
One-pager: A4 proportions in RGB, suitable as a layout starter. It is not a CMYK print-production file.
Replace sample copy with your own content before publishing. Preserve logo proportions and leave clear space around the artwork.
